args.title: Fix incorrect npm run serve command in README
args.body: File: README.md. The "Running locally" section (step 5) tells users to run `npm run serve`, but no such script exists in package.json, causing a "Missing script: serve" error. Update the README to reference the correct existing script for starting the API (e.g. `npm start` or `npm run start`, whichever matches package.json), so the documented steps actually work.
